scope: Complete opt-in insertion profiles for all four existing Heltec WiFi LoRa32 entries. No new catalog IDs, canonical anchors, default artwork or native assets.

policy.insertion: Populate both complete 18-contact main strips with straight downward male headers; leave all four V4 auxiliary holes unpopulated downward or populate upward. Every auxiliary contact remains available for wiring.
policy.v3Inference: The nominal V3.2 assembly is an explicitly identified inference from the manufacturer compatible-family evidence. The later V3.7 STEP is corroboration of the unchanged mainheader family, not exact V3.2 production CAD. No coordinate tolerance is enlarged and the V3.2 body uses its own 50.2 × 25.5 mm reference.
policy.body: Use reviewed material and real USB/coax projections, with narrow antenna tails rather than an annotation rectangle. Non-contact OLED/cover artwork remains representative.
policy.preservation: The explicit saved view selector activates only on new fitted instances. Default and old scale-only instances retain their exact anchors/artwork/native exports.
policy.accuracy: No KiCad footprint or approximate generated 3D accuracy assessment is promoted by the insertion profile.
